# GlyphLock LLC

GlyphLock LLC is an Arizona limited liability company founded on May 24, 2025, in El Mirage, Arizona. GlyphLock develops evidence infrastructure for identity, permission, secure QR, venue operations, financial accountability, APIs, hardware-assisted workflows, and governance.

## NUPS

NUPS means Nexus Unified POS System. It is venue-operations software that connects identity, role, contract, shift, register, payout, reconciliation, and audit records. NUPS can package references from payment and hospitality systems, but those source systems remain authoritative for the events they control.
